purpose: Prove that the open implementation can reproduce one complete causal midpoint segment path as a single deterministic computation rather than as disconnected arithmetic identities.

pass_proves: The content-addressed open implementation reproduces the bound first-half forward state, loss, backward state, midpoint update, rebuild state, and second-half forward population under the frozen arithmetic contract.
The no-update open replay is identical to the bound no-update oracle at every authoritative checkpoint.
The full-update open replay is identical to the bound full-update oracle at every authoritative checkpoint.
The treatment executes without a closed LibNC or NNCP runtime dependency.
pass_does_not_prove: Any Hutter Prize eligibility or score credit.
That a compact student or Delta-MIDAS adapter recovers the full-update benefit.

governance.isolated_primitive_budget_origin: The probability-adjoint gate begins the bounded closure count.
governance.budget_exhaustion_action: Pause primitive porting and execute this integrated gate or pivot to a compact student; do not authorize another isolated primitive.

activation_dependencies.current_hardware_effect: Arm B must terminalize and release its lease before execution on the sole available host.

population.source: Inherited byte-for-byte from the retained delta_midas_deep_residual_65536_q0_v1 oracle population.
population.freeze_rule: Execution is forbidden until all pending digests are replaced by concrete SHA-256 values in a new lock receipt. Population order, segment boundaries, truth bits, and stream assignment then become immutable.

arms.O: Bound oracle no-midpoint trajectory and state sequence.
arms.K: Open forward, loss bookkeeping, and full state rebuild with the midpoint write forced to exact zero.
arms.F: Open forward, exact loss, complete open backward, exact midpoint optimizer update, deterministic state rebuild, and second-half forward.
arms.S: Same implementation and update magnitude as F, but using one preregistered cyclic permutation of first-half truth-to-event associations.

execution_graph.name: first_half_open_forward
requirements: Consume only content-addressed model, state, tensor, truth, and population inputs.
Materialize every update-relevant activation needed by the bound backward graph.
Emit rolling and checkpoint state hashes.

execution_graph.name: first_half_loss
requirements: Use the exact bound truth path and loss definition.
Emit the scalar loss and output adjoint population before any parameter update.

execution_graph.name: complete_open_backward
requirements: Execute the complete reverse graph in frozen order.
Compare every authoritative adjoint checkpoint with the captured oracle.
Stop at the first mismatch and emit a bounded divergence trace.

execution_graph.name: midpoint_update
requirements: Apply the exact bound optimizer equations, moments, step index, dtype conversions, and write order.
K performs the same reads and bookkeeping but commits an exact zero write.
F and S commit exactly one midpoint update.

execution_graph.name: state_rebuild
requirements: Recompute every state that the bound oracle recomputes after the midpoint write.
Do not reuse stale hidden, attention, optimizer, cache, or arithmetic state unless the oracle contract explicitly reuses it.

execution_graph.name: second_half_open_forward
requirements: Execute the bound second-half population in original order.
Compare logits, probabilities, truth-path loss, hidden state, cache state, and all future-affecting persistent state.

determinism.repeat_requirement: All materialized treatment tensors, rolling hashes, terminal hashes, and decision fields are byte-identical across two clean executions.

synchronization.rolling_hash_scope: Every segment boundary and every authoritative phase boundary.
synchronization.first_divergence_trace: Retain the preceding checkpoint, mismatching element index, expected and observed bit patterns, operation identity, source location, and arithmetic mode.

pass_requires: K equals O at every authoritative checkpoint.
F equals the bound full-update oracle at every authoritative checkpoint.
The complete 65,536-event population is consumed exactly once in frozen order.
S differs from F and is not more aligned with the bound full-update oracle than F.
Two clean treatment executions are byte-identical.
No closed LibNC or NNCP executable, shared object, service, or generated result participates in treatment execution beyond immutable captured oracle inputs.
terminal_decision.on_pass: Authorize delta_midas_functional_jvp_65536_q0_v1. Compression credit remains zero.
terminal_decision.on_forward_mismatch: Authorize one correction-only forward implementation successor at the first divergence.
terminal_decision.on_backward_mismatch: Authorize one correction-only backward implementation successor at the first divergence; do not add another primitive candidate.
terminal_decision.on_update_or_rebuild_mismatch: Authorize one correction-only integrated-replay successor; do not reinterpret partial parity.
terminal_decision.on_subscale_or_unrecoverable_closure: Pause exact-port work and pivot the family to one compact open student proposal grounded in the retained functional residual evidence.
